shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes, Caverns basements, ~4× faster gen, full-mesh elevator, vanilla-parity border stack — and now a unified sky-mass: wall band + fog hole covered into one seamless rock field, shadows scoped to the silhouette, rooftops fade into ledges. Verification pending.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~58 files / ~12,300 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample world position).

**Map sizes curated** (126 / 190-default / 254). `MapSizes` swapped by reflection for the dialog's duration only; `Clamp` snaps to an offered size.

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between `RegionType.Portal` ends (stairs subclass `Building_Door`) conduct connectivity **without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **We patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal** — the perf-mod compat guarantee. Portal regions are ONE CELL; `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M`.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site; never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder (traversal at `Pawn_PathFollower`) · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
`ScenParts` (41) spawns colonists mid-generation. **Carve runs in a `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix** (before `FinalizeInit`). Genstep-time band math uses `TryPendingSurfaceRect`. Start spot clamped at genstep 40 (+24-cell pod margin) + `RescueStrandedColonists` + full-band sweep with census + **`CarveStartClearing`** on zero-standable surfaces (mountain-base start; verified — run #131 showed it also fires on ~all-water ocean tiles; "solid rock" log wording is a cosmetic mislabel).

---

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, fix pending verification)

Reload broke everything at once (`Banded == false` everywhere). **Mechanism — cache poisoning:** `Map.ExposeData` runs `ConstructComponents()` (fresh EMPTY `ABBandMap`) before deserializing the real one; loading-while-playing keeps rendering alive → `CompOf(Find.CurrentMap)` mid-load latches the empty instance. **Fix:** (1) `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive`; (2) `FinalizeInit` unconditionally `RebindAfterLoad`s + drops the biome memo. **Also fixed:** uniqueID-keyed statics → `ConditionalWeakTable` (`ABWormhole.byMap`, `spikeLayouts`); load-time camera move deferred via `ExecuteWhenFinished`.
**Verification pending:** menu-load · load-while-playing · double cycle · `AB2: band info` after each.

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / SKY VEGETATION / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell is a parameter) · sky biome locked to surface · `SeedFlora` · Biomes! Caverns basements (band-scoped carve, scribed `basementBiome`, foreign gensteps confined). Compat watch: perf-mod biome caching → `AB2: biome report` `<-- MISMATCH`. Stalagmite-leak + Earthen Depths temp pending.

# 4. CAMERA — verified in play
`viewBand` on the component · free pan via `CurrentViewRect` clip · `ABBandCurtain` draws `map.MapEdgeMaterial` at `WorldClipper` altitude.

# 5. MAP GENERATION — profiled, ~4× faster, closed
Crowdedness mechanism (linear `ListerThings.Remove`); `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands`. Carve 16.9 s → ~4.2 s. Documented fat: cavern spawn-then-hollow, RockChunks scoping.

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — measured, 96 pawns
59.6 fps vsync-pinned; mod ≈ 2% frame budget. All visual work (fans, fades, rings, cover) is **bake-time section-mesh geometry — zero per-frame cost**.

# 7. SKY SYNC / BELOW-DRAW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync (roof beats edifice; `AB_WallTop` dontRender + `ShowsBelow`); suspended during carve. Below-draw: pawns + non-pawn realtime things, all three phases.

**Vanilla-parity border stack (untested):** shared `ABNineFan` (vanilla 9-vert cell fan, SW-first, no uvs).
- **Below fog** (`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`): vanilla FogOfWar corner smoothing sampled one band down (black-squares fix); fogged cell = all-covered fan, explored neighbours get partial skirts; gutter/off-map counts as fogged; fog altitude = FogOfWar (depth safety).
- **Below edge shadows** (`SectionLayer_ABBelowEdgeShadows`): vanilla EdgeShadows verbatim via shared `ABEdgeShadowGeometry` (four asymmetric corner blocks live ONCE, used by three callers), casters one band down, masked by `ShowsBelow`.
- **Meadow fade** (`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`): skirt strips DELETED → meadow terrain's own world-position material as 9-vert fade fan OVER the mass cell; clones at `lowQueue+2+spread` (precedence order preserved), +0.04 alt (cutout depth-tie win). `IsMeadowGround` = property-based (Soil/Gravel/`AB_RoofSurface` special-cases, else non-Hard && (natural || fertility>0), water excluded): rough patches + biome soils + ROOFTOPS all fade; RoughHewn stays MASS (natural=false, no overlap).
- **Rooftop fade**: `AB_RoofSurface` is Hard/TerrainHard (ignores vertex alpha) → `FadeCloneFor` swaps the clone's shader to TerrainFadeRough + `AlphaAddTex` (the TerrainDef.cs pattern). **Shader assignment resets Unity renderQueue — set queue AFTER.**
- **Drop-off ring**: open-air cells bordering mass get an EdgeShadow fan INTO the open-air cell (cliff-lip elevation cue).

# 8. SKY-MASS UNIFICATION (2026-07-29, untested — the "outline errors / fog hole" session)
User screenshot: fill ring → visible wall rows drawing native lips + edge/sun shadows → fog blob = three nested border systems. Now ONE:
- **Cover** (`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`): natural-rock WALL cells (and fogged ore) covered with properly-masked atlas tiles + corner fillers at `coverQueue = max(cutout, edgeShadow, fog)+1`, altitude = FogOfWar (beats depth-written wall sprites). Wall band + fogged interior + fill ring = one continuous field; lips only at the true silhouette. Covered walls type from THEIR OWN def (not ground). **Visible ore keeps its native sprite** (prospecting info); **fogged ore is covered like plain rock** — a fog dot in the unified field would itself be an ore tell. Fades over covered cells use `fadeClonesHigh` (coverQueue+1+spread).
- **Shadow scoping** (`ABSkyMassShadowScope`): `SectionLayer_EdgeShadows.Regenerate` + internal `SectionLayer_SunShadows.Regenerate` prefix-REPLACED on banded maps with verbatim vanilla geometry + one filter — a sky-band natural-rock caster contributes nothing toward a mass cell. Silhouette shadows (onto meadow/rooftop/air) kept; SunShadow base quads kept (alpha-0 = no displacement, concealed by cover) so skirt indices stay vanilla; bounds inflation replicated. Exception → vanilla fallback for the section.
- Known cosmetic: ore corner-fillers poke ~0.1 cell into covered neighbours and get clipped by the cover (subtle). Mined tunnels under the mass keep lowQueue fill — things inside draw over it (pre-existing, unchanged).
- Fog gameplay preserved: cover CONCEALS (fog data untouched; unfog on mining works; fog geometry lands only on covered cells since fog starts ≥2 rows deep).

# 9. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested)
Ladder 1×1 / Stairs 2×2 / Grand 3×3 (one direction) · **Elevator 2×2, every level, FULL MESH**. `counterparts` list scribed (legacy key migrates); shaft collapses when any member dies; metallic-only, 150 stuff. Known: `Carry` latent hole. History: tickerType Never ⇒ `openInt` forced · rotation offset · landing pocket `ExpandedBy` · **`placeWorkers` REPLACES on inherit**.

# 10. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred
BM swaps rock graphicData + rebuilds 5 stone terrain graphics + per-map ore recolors (`graphicInt` poke), at startup AND settings apply. Covered: cap variant mode + live-graphic validation; below `t.Print` live; terrain via `TerrainGrid.GetMaterial`; **`ABMinedRockLookup` color now read LIVE** (was build-once — stale after mid-game settings). Mountains Retexture = texture-only, transparent.

# 11. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · why is this pawn stuck · ABStuckWatchdog (verdict-contradiction unfixed) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles (`DrawBelowAirMask` gates fog fans) · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · toggle cap corner fillers.

# 12. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify visual batch v2**: unified mass (no internal lips/shadow rims, fog hole filled, ore blobs visible, silhouette shadows intact) · plateau fade vs all grounds · rooftop fade · below fog/edge shadows · cliff ring · shadows correct on SURFACE band (scoped layers must be vanilla-identical there).
2. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
3. **Verify elevator**.
4. **COMBAT** — 575 LOC, never verified.
5. **WATERFALLS — stored.** Rule: upper-band water adjacent to `ShowsBelow` ⇒ fall lip; south-face animated strip + mist flecks + sustainer. Scope choice pending: (a) full incl. sky streams, (b) renderer-only, (c) later.
6. Mountain sun-shadow onto surface below (parked) · vertical power conduit · DrawDynamicThings isolation · compat audit · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths · transplant · reachability-proxy audit.

# 13. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · per-cell gensteps scope safely · reuse the engine's object (BiomeAt/CurrentViewRect/MapEdgeMaterial/9-vert fan) · fog softness lives in EXPLORED neighbours' fans · classify terrain by PROPERTY not def identity · **concealment ≠ deletion: cover fog/walls visually, never touch the data — and mind info leaks (a fog dot inside a unified field is itself a tell)** · **to replace a vanilla SectionLayer's output, prefix-return-false its Regenerate and re-emit with a filter; extract the verbatim geometry ONCE and share it** · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — key by Map/CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the depth tiebreaker vs depth-writing cutouts · **material.shader assignment resets renderQueue — set queue after** · float Color ≠ Color32 · green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · build-once caches go stale under settings-reapplying mods.

# 14. PUBLISHING
Store page honest (update when elevator + visual batch verify). known-issues.json v2 (10 entries; no-elevator + hard-fog-squares entries now stale). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ BM only for compat runs). Playing-gated debug actions via Debug Actions menu. New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
